# Finite vertex-Menger proof subset

Source: [Edouard Bonnet's polynomial-grid-minor-theorem project](https://github.com/EdouardBonnet/polynomial-grid-minor-theorem/tree/69d1714f3daa5ac49924b99950b4f4e283107cbe).

The four files in `Lax17Proofs/Source/` are copied unchanged from
`proofs/Lax17Proofs/Source/` at commit
`69d1714f3daa5ac49924b99950b4f4e283107cbe`:
`Degree.lean`, `Paths.lean`, `MengerDefs.lean`, and `Menger.lean`.
The upstream Apache 2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

These files form a closed dependency subset using Mathlib directly.
The upstream Lean and Mathlib pins match this project's 4.33.0 versions.
The upstream concept/contract files are not imported. The proof endpoint is
`Lax17Proofs.SimpleGraph.Menger.finite_vertex_menger_sharp`.
`Lax17Proofs.lean` is a local entry point, not an upstream source file.
